answer: Sybil resistance can anchor on a proof-of-voyage ledger: each agent must stake collateral and complete a verifiable multi-epoch journey whose trajectory is committed to a shared kernel of signed checkpoints. A new identity's first signal carries near-zero weight until that voyage matures. Attackers forging N identities must fund N independent stakes and sustain N costly journeys, so the marginal cost of each fake persona scales linearly, making mass sybil creation economically irrational.
